title: A Sol is Longer Than a Day
text: One Sol (a Martian day) is 24 hours and 37 minutes — just a bit longer than an Earth day!
source: NASA Mars Exploration — OSDR (Open Science Data Repository)

title: Mars Has Almost No Magnetic Field
text: Earth's magnetic field protects us from most space radiation. Mars lost its global magnetic field billions of years ago, so astronauts need extra shielding.

title: NASA Grew Potatoes in Space Soil!
text: Scientists at NASA and the International Potato Center grew potatoes in soil that was almost like Mars dirt. Potatoes are tough — they can grow in very harsh conditions!
source: NASA — Can Plants Grow on Mars?

title: Astronauts Ate Space Lettuce!
text: In 2015, astronauts on the International Space Station grew and ate red romaine lettuce for the first time. It was part of NASA's Veggie experiment!

title: Radishes Grow Super Fast in Space!
text: NASA picked radishes for space farming tests because they grow in just 27 days. Astronauts on the ISS grew them in the Advanced Plant Habitat in 2020!
